_about: Flight log lines. The client picks lines[event.pick % lines.length] for the event kind. Tokens: {bird} name, {He}/{he}/{him}/{his} pronouns, {place} nearest place name (omit the sentence part if unknown), {speed} mph, {friend} recipient name.
takeoff: Released from your loft. Looked back once.
Left in a hurry. Forgot nothing, owns nothing.
Circled the block to show off, then got going.
takeoff_return: Left {friend}'s sill. Did not tidy up.
Homeward bound. Knows the way, mostly.
nightwait: Released after dark. Refused. Leaves at sunrise.
It is night. {bird} is asleep on the note.
cruising: Making good time and knows it.
Holding a steady {speed}. Wind is cooperating.
Overtook a seagull. Did not look back.
Nothing to report. {He} would like that noted.
food: Circled a hot dog cart twice. Kept going.
Passed a bagel shop. Kept it professional.
Saw a dropped pretzel. Chose the mission. Barely.
Smelled a bakery near {place}. Stayed strong.
landmark: Used {place} to check {his} bearings. Close enough.
weather_rain_geared: Rain started. The gear is doing its job.
weather_headwind: Headwind. Flapping harder and complaining about it.
weather_cold_geared: Cold up here. Dressed for it.
weather_snow_geared: Snow. The scarf was a good call.
dusk: Sun went down. Found a barn. The cows are fine with it.
Roosting on a water tower with a nice view.
Too dark to fly. Asleep on a ledge near {place}.
sunrise: Up at first light. Back in the air.
Left the roost. Did not say goodbye.
delay_minor: Stopped to look at a puddle. Moving again.
Followed a pizza box for three blocks.
delay_major: Found a statue. Sat on its head. Lost track of time.
Joined some other pigeons. Remembered the job eventually.
Found a pretzel. Chose the pretzel.
landing: Landed. Would like a snack and some respect.
Touched down. Pretended it was easy.
landing_tumbler: Landed with a backflip. Nobody asked.
